 Talladega Race Results: NASCAR Trucks (October 23, 2026)
 Shane Walters October 23, 2026 Tony Stewart and Cleetus McFarland raced in the NASCAR Truck Series event at Talladega Superspeedway
 NASCAR Truck Series drivers are on the grid in Talladega, Alabama. The 2.66-mile oval of Talladega Superspeedway is set to host the Love’s RV Stop 225.
 View Talladega race results below.
 Talladega Menu
 Truck: Qual | Race 
O’Reilly: Qual | Race 
Cup: Qual 
 Ty Majeski and Sammy Smith set the front row. 85 laps of truck racing are up next…
 Love’s RV Stop 225
Stage 1 – Report
 Laps: 20 (1-20 / 85)
 Green flag, Majeski is clear into turn one. Sammy Smith has a run off turn two. He jumps to the lead and moves to the bottom lane.
 Lap 10, Justin Haley is shoved to the race lead. Austin Green leaves his bumper and Green takes the lead.
 Lap 13, Justin Haley slows with a flat tire. The field narrowly avoids him as he dives for the pit lane, no caution.
 Lap 15, Christian Eckes blows and tire and slams the wall. No caution as he heads to the pit lane.
 Lap 16, Gio Ruggiero is shoved to the lead via the outside lane.
 Lap 17, big crash off turn two! Stewart Friesen slows with an issue and the field stacks up behind him. Big hit for Kris Wright. Tony Stewart, Cleetus McFarland and many others are collected. The red flag is out.
 That caution ends the stage. Gio Ruggiero wins stage one at Talladega Superspeedway!
 Talladega Race Results (Stage 1) : 1. Giovanni Ruggiero; 2. Kaden Honeycutt; 3. Austin Green; 4. Corey Heim; 5. Layne Riggs; 6. Ben Rhodes; 7. Tanner Gray; 8. Ty Majeski; 9. Sammy Smith; 10. Mini Tyrrell
 Love’s RV Stop 225
Stage 2 – Report
 Laps: 22 (18-39 / 85)
 Ruggiero leads the field to the pit lane but he’s stuck on the pit lane with an issue. Green wins the race to the pit exit.
 Green flag on stage two, Majeski is shoved clear for the lead into turn one.
 Lap 25, Austin Green is shoved to the lead. Corey Heim slows and heads to the pit lane with a flat tire.
 Chandler Smith picks up a flat tire. He heads to the pit lane under green.
 Lap 34, Grant Enfinger is shoved to the lead.
 Lap 38, Tanner Gray leads a train on the outside lane. Race leader Grant Enfinger picks up a flat tire! Somehow they avoid a crash. But the caution is out for debris.
 This stage is over with the caution flag. Tanner Gray wins stage two at Talladega Superspeedway!
 Talladega Race Results (Stage 2) : 1. Tanner Gray; 2. Layne Riggs; 3. Ben Rhodes; 4. Kaden Honeycutt; 5. Ty Majeski; 6. Landen Lewis; 7. Dawson Sutton; 8. Austin Green; 9. Justin Haley; 10. Brenden Queen
 Love’s RV Stop 225
Stage 3 – Report
 Laps: 46 (40-85 / 85)
 Gray leads the field to the pit lane. Sutton wins the race to the pit exit.
 Green flag on stage three, Majeski is shoved to the lead.
 Lap 50, Cole Butcher has lost his right-side window and the caution is out.
 Majeski leads the field to the pit lane. Riggs wins the race to the pit exit.
 Green, Gray clears Riggs for the race lead. Gray throws a huge block on Queen to hold the race lead.
 29 to go
 29 to go, Honeycutt to the lead. Jake Garcia is turned into the outside wall behind them and multiple trucks are collected.
 Green, Ben Rhodes is shoved clear of Honeycutt. Rhodes drops to the bottom.
 16 to go, Majeski shoves Riggs to the lead on the outside lane. Tanner Gray leads the inside lane.
 13 to go, Sammy Smith to the lead.
 7 to go, Thomas Annunziata gets loose off a bump draft and he’s turned into the outside wall. Grant Enfinger slams into the side of him as he bounces off the wall. The caution is out.
 Green with 2 to go, Sammy Smith leads the inside lane as Riggs leads the outside. Majeski shoves Smith clear and he looks to his outside into turn three.
 1 to go, Smith wiggles off a shove at the line. Majeski is clear into turn one. Multiple cars crash behind them. Majeski throws a block on Honeycutt but Honeycutt works inside.
 Majeski and Honeycutt have lost speed as they fight for space. Smith has momentum on the outside off turn four.
 Sammy Smith wins at Talladega Superspeedway!
 Credit: TALLADEGA, ALABAMA – OCTOBER 23: Sammy Smith, driver of the #7 Spectrum Chevrolet, takes the checkered flag to win the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series Love’s RV Stop 225 at Talladega Superspeedway on October 23, 2026 in Talladega, Alabama.
